events.description: The camera wearer continuously walks along the sandy beach, following a track between low vegetated dunes on the left and the ocean on the right toward a rocky jetty.
The wearer moves through several nearby beachgoers, including a person crossing the sand with a folded beach chair.
The wearer leaves the busier upper-beach area and reaches the more open shoreline route with the surf clearly visible to the right.
The wearer approaches and passes scattered groups of adults and children gathered, sitting, and playing near the waterline.
While walking, the wearer holds a short cylindrical piece of wood and briefly extends or points it toward the ocean before lowering it.
Near the rocky jetty, the wearer passes beach chairs and two people standing beside a tripod and a blue bag.

warnings: The video was represented by frames sampled about 6.1 seconds apart, so boundaries for brief hand and object actions are approximate.
